title: Documented limitation: a dictionary_add teach has no cues, so nothing gates it
why_real: This is NOT desired behaviour, it is a recorded limitation of the current system: because dictionary_add stores empty context_cues, the Groww memory rewrites the ordinary verb 'grow' in a sentence about houseplants that has nothing to do with the brand, and there is no cue gate to stop it.

inputs.asr: the plants will grow faster now
inputs.formatted: The plants will grow faster now.

expected.memory_aware: The plants will Groww faster now.
expected.reason: ok: dictionary_add memories carry no context_cues, so the cue gate never fires (documented limitation, catalogue Q2)
